versions.line: A task that waits for hours on its own command, or on something that never comes
A task's result shows once in the chat, as the chat's own reply
A task no longer stops while its to-dos aren't done
A task that's waiting on its helpers no longer writes "My command is still running…" three times in its…
After you press Run it, the task's card shows one quiet line
A task that stops partway, with no result
Claude can now put a file from your Mac into a page's upload box in the Claude app's browser
The tree on a task's card no longer breaks under a helper that has a line of what it's doing
claudopus.ai asks before it counts visits
A helper's result goes to the task that started it, not to your chat
What waits for you stays at the top of the panel in the order it came
When Claude Code refuses a task's command, its card now shows the command whole
Questions, allow boxes, key and password boxes and their notices now use the same plain words everywhere
The reply box above the chat no longer flashes blue or jumps while you type
A release goes out within a minute of your press
The chat no longer shows a red "A hook blocked your prompt" card each time Claude Code tells it that a…
A program a task's command left running is named on its card by what that command does
A task whose step ended while all its helpers sit silent (nothing new from them for 12 minutes
The reply box above the chat is as wide as the bar and grows taller as you type, up to eight lines
When you press Release it seconds after a task asks, while it is still finishing
The panel and the bar above the prompt redraw themselves far less often with nothing new
The banner at the top of the README shows the octopus in 3D, built from cubes and holding task cards
The panel no longer lets you scroll far past its cards
When you answer a question in your own words in the box above the chat, only the big Send button shows now
Check now in Config shows a newer version right under the press, with its Update button (Download
claudopus.ai has a new home page
A click on a button no longer goes missing because the panel was drawn again around it
A release now runs its checks on this Mac while GitHub runs its own, instead of one after the other
Removes a link to a local folder that an earlier release took in by mistake
A task that ends its step to wait for its helpers, or for something it asked Claudopus to start it again for
